description: This file contains test suites for the tenantClient utility functions, including tests for normalization, fetching tenants, selecting tenants, and setting active tenant in local storage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches session tenants from API and returns an array of tenant objects.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Sets active tenant, makes API call to save selection, updates localStorage.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in localStorage and removes legacy key.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from local storage.
